text: Have had several Spigen cases over the years, and this one has the same high quality that I've come to expect from the brand. Fit is exact. TPU is firmer and grips phone more tightly than other TPU cases I've had. Appreciate the textured exterior - the S22 Ultra is heavy, and exceedingly slippery when naked. Although this case is still not what I'd call "grippy", it's sufficient for the task. I also appreciate that Spigen had this case available for order before the S22 Ultra launch day. I don't usually jump on the latest tech, but my old phone was on life support, I'd pre-ordered an S22, and needed to switch to the new phone quickly once it was in-hand. Given the obscene cost of the S22 and its almost ungrippable exterior, I didn't dare handle it until it had a proper case. Thanks Spigen and Amazon!
label: Positive

text: Yes, it's flexible, but it is not easy to install. I also purchased a charging stand for my Ionic and this case makes it too big to fit. It's not unattractive, but it is noticeably bigger and in my opinion, detracts from the sleek design of the watch. The increase in size also prevents correctly entering the locking code. I actually disabled the code rather than fumble around with trying to touch tiny numbers with my fat fingers through this screen. I won't return it because it's not worth the hassle, but I'm ordering the traditional flat screen protectors as a replacement.

text: OUCH! I have been a LEO for 14 years. I love the ability to have the in ear sound of my radio but not at the cost of me going nuts. First, it looks good, but that is where the positives end. When I connected the earbud to the tube, it went in fine with no issues, but when I tried to put it in my ear....it would not stay! The earbud would not stay in my ear and the tube started hurting my ear. The sad thing is that the tube is from Zeadio. I was really disappointed in this. I was really hoping that it would improve the sound quality, but it did not.

text: Easy to use per the video - I could have lined up a little better around the home key.....make sure the home button is all in the hole. text: The micro-cable charging cord has a "shaky" connection with its respective port and amazingly there is no light indicator displaying the progress of the unit's charge like just about every product of its kind I've had!! There is not even a solid light indicating that's its charging at all a little worrisome considering the semi-loose cord-port connection I described earlier. This is nothing more than a company cost effective stamped out cheaply made product with high margins and low quality. Here's a cliche-"you get what you pay for". The rating on this product was 4.6 when I purchased it and 4.3 when it arrived two days later. I have never been so disappointed with an Amazon product-it's a piece of JUNK!

text: I really like the style and price of this lifeproof & purchased it with the thought of it being useful at the beach and pool. It does keep the phone safe from water damage but my speaker has become distorted & my camera has been affected the most, my picture quality has went down tremendously. I can’t use my flash or the picture is just a pink blur (the color from the case interacts with flash). My camera also will not focus now, it moves in and out. I’m disappointed. My phone works well without the case and it’s a hassle to have to take it off for pictures. I wouldn’t recommend you buy this.
label: Neutral
